title: Orange Pudding French Toast
description: A twist on classic French toast, featuring a creamy orange pudding filling.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Cook the bread slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
While the bread is cooking, mix the orange pudding and zest in a separate bowl.
Once the bread is cooked, spread a spoonful of the orange pudding mixture onto each slice.
